title: Deploy workflow: from Run workflow to a current release
caption: .github/workflows/deploy.yml. The build job has no secrets; the deploy job needs build and e2e green, the production environment's approval, and runs only from main or a v* tag.

steps.label: Actions > Deploy > Run workflow (main or v*)
refuse other refs; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; lint, typecheck, test, build
pack-release.sh → release/<sha>/, SHA256SUMS check, tarball + SHA-256 output
same commit, in parallel (portal, platform-admin, storefront, ota-admin, storefront-stripe, SDK smoke)
green (a red run blocks the deploy)
sha == GITHUB_SHA; download; re-check tarball SHA-256 and SHA256SUMS
rsync -a --delete release/<sha>/ → /srv/velexis/incoming/<sha>/ (host alias velexis-vm, BatchMode, pinned host key)
current: /srv/velexis/releases/<sha>
steps.note: The job fails unless this line matches.
